0022600114.text: The New York Knicks, 0-1 and on a one-game losing streak, host the 0-1 Orlando Magic, with the Knicks 9th in the East and the Magic 11th. The Knicks sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, while the Magic are 4th in the Southeast, 1 game back, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet after the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, when the Knicks won the last meeting 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while the Knicks have no one listed as unavailable.
